create.name: Christabel Zamor
create.bio:
Christabel Zamor is a breathwork teacher and the founder of Breath of Bliss, a school of ceremonial breathwork she describes as angelic breathwork. She holds master's degrees in Mythology and Depth Psychology and in Cultural Anthropology, and she is a certified life coach. Her approach draws on Science of Mind, A Course in Miracles, spiritual psychology and years of pilgrimage and devotional practice, woven together with music, prayer and movement. Earlier in her career she was known as a hoop dance teacher, and she also created Breathfest, a travelling breathwork festival.

Through Breath of Bliss she leads group breath ceremonies and trains facilitators in three levels: a ten-week online initiation, a six-month online guide training and a live in-person immersion. Over two decades she has trained more than a thousand facilitators and has led ceremonies for groups of several hundred. She has produced a series of guided breathwork audio journeys, sells recorded ceremony libraries and self-paced trainings, has presented for Mindvalley, and teaches on The Shift Network.

courses.title: The Psychoactive Guide Training (Breath of Bliss Level 2)
courses.description: A six-month online facilitator training with live group calls, mentoring and community support. Students learn to lead Breath of Bliss ceremonies online and in person.

courses.title: The High Frequency Channel Initiation (Breath of Bliss Level 3)
courses.description: A live, in-person immersion for students who have completed Levels 1 and 2 online. Participants lead ceremonies several times a day and receive detailed feedback on presence, voice and holding a group.

courses.title: 4 Audio Breathwork
courses.description: All four Breath of Bliss guided audio journeys (I AM Bliss, I AM Light, I AM Love and I AM Passion) to use at home. Each pairs breath, music and spoken guidance, from gentle and heart-opening to fast and intense.

courses.title: I AM Bliss
courses.description: A single guided breathwork audio journey focused on softening and opening the heart. A gentle, nourishing introduction to the Breath of Bliss style.

courses.title: Temple of Light Bundle
courses.description: A library of 28 recorded Breath of Bliss ceremonies to follow at home. It gathers the themed seven-ceremony collections into one set.

courses.title: Lead Mystical Breathwork 1.0
courses.description: A self-paced training in the foundations of leading Breath of Bliss ceremonies, with a year of replay access. Aimed at people who want to start guiding groups.

courses.title: Lead Mystical Breathwork 2.0
courses.description: The follow-on self-paced training in more advanced facilitation of mystical breathwork. Includes a year of replay access.

courses.title: Manifest
courses.description: A four-part recorded breathwork series on clarifying intentions and living with purpose. Access to the replays lasts one year.

courses.title: The Sacred Slowdown
courses.description: A recorded breathwork journey about slowing down and softening into a calmer pace of life. Replays are available for one year.

courses.title: Miraculous
courses.description: A recorded breathwork programme on letting go of limiting beliefs and opening to abundance. Includes one year of replay access.

free_resources.title: The Bliss Experience
free_resources.description: A free six-minute Breath of Bliss activation video, sent after signing up with an email address. A short taste of her guided breathwork style.
